items.title: Tracker eviction orphans a zero-debt StreamPressureBinding
items.detail: Decision 7. No code. The direct fix (never evict an entry anything still holds) is correct but changes capacity. A resident binding would hold its project about 905 s after its last append, so sustained first-seen churn above about 18 projects/s would get 503 project_tracker_capacity (about 54/s today). HANDLE_IDLE_EVICT_SECS=0 would let the tracker fill permanently. Options: (a) the fix, plus MAX_TRACKED_PROJECTS 16,384 -> 32,768 (about 16 MiB), plus refusing HANDLE_IDLE_EVICT_SECS=0 at boot (recommended); (b) the fix at today's cap; (c) re-point the binding to the live entry (a shard.rs synchronization change). The bug itself is low impact.
